title: Sinusoidal positional encoding
summary: Build the sin and cos position table with interleaved columns and base 10000, and add it to a batch of token embeddings.

mutants.add_in_place: Adds the table into x with +=, so the caller's embeddings change.
mutants.blocked_layout: Puts all the sines in the first half of the columns and all the cosines in the second half.
mutants.exponent_i_over_d: Uses the exponent i / d_model in place of 2i / d_model.
mutants.odd_uses_even_width: Divides the exponent by 2 * (d_model // 2), so an odd d_model gets the frequencies of d_model - 1.
mutants.positions_from_one: Starts the positions at 1, so row 0 is the code of position 1.
mutants.sin_cos_swapped: Puts the cosine in column 2i and the sine in column 2i+1.
